standard_prerequisites.use: The characterization of finite presentation of morphisms of affines by finite presentation of the corresponding algebra map (Morphisms, lemma-locally-finite-presentation-characterize) and the algebra lemma presenting a finite presentation algebra over a filtered colimit at a finite stage (Algebra, lemma-limit-module-finite-presentation); cited inputs with the translation written in the retained span.

core_obligations: Rewrite f : Spec B -> Spec A with B of finite presentation as an A-algebra.
Apply the algebraic finite-presentation-at-a-finite-stage lemma to descend to A_0 of finite type over Z.
Reassemble the cartesian diagram of affines.

proof_roadmap.step: Translate the morphism to an algebra of finite presentation.
Descend the algebras and take spectra.

difficulty_reason: Given a morphism f : X -> S of affine schemes of finite presentation, the lemma produces a cartesian diagram with X_0 -> S_0 affine, S_0 of finite type over Z, and f_0 of finite type, through which X -> S factors. The retained proof writes the translation into algebra: S = Spec A, X = Spec B, finite presentation of f means B is of finite presentation as an A-algebra (via Morphisms, lemma-locally-finite-presentation-characterize), and the claim is then Algebra, lemma-limit-module-finite-presentation. Retained author proof at lines 9756-9764.
